identityClassification.selectionRule: exact source/workspace/content bindings joined to the explicit Graphify execution; sorted by normalized source_ref, source_revision, content_digest; bounded by --limit

workspaceRevisionAuthority: atlas_workspace_source_bindings; packet workspace columns are not used for qualification
mismatchDiagnosticScope: explicit admitted workspace revision and execution only; historical rows are not used for current-gate promotion

hashGrain.bindingContentDigest: whole-source digest; exact Graphify file content hash
hashGrain.codebaseChunkIndexContentHash: per-chunk digest; not equal to a whole-source digest for multi-chunk files
hashGrain.exactJoinAllowedOnlyWhen: a separately proven packet/chunk binding supplies the exact chunk digest
